Migration Assistant for Amazon OpenSearch Service is available as an AWS Solution with
comprehensive documentation, deployment templates, and source code. To get started with
Migration Assistant:
To access Migration Assistant resources
1.
Review the complete solution documentation at Migration Assistant for Amazon OpenSearch
Service solution overview.
Migration scenarios
619
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
2.
Understand the costs and requirements by reading the deployment planning guide.
3.
Deploy the solution using the deployment instructions and follow the usage guide to perform
your migration.
For developers and advanced users, Migration Assistant source code and additional documentation
are available in the OpenSearch migrations GitHub repository.

hierarchy.parent: Migrating to OpenSearch Service with Migration Assistant
